design_philosophy: Pragmatic Futurism: Clean, modern, corporate enterprise-security layout. Prioritizes white/light-slate backgrounds, generous whitespace, subtle depth, and restrained typography. Moves away from the dark 'hacker' aesthetic.

scales.h1: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
scales.mono_data: font-mono text-sm text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 px-1 py-0.5 rounded

typography.instructions: Use restrained, smaller heading sizes as dictated. NO giant font-black display types. Headings should feel professional and readable. Use mono font ONLY for technical data (CVEs, IOCs) and NOT for general headings.

colors.instructions: Overall site is Light-Dominant. Use #0A1220 (Navy) for specific high-contrast sections like the Footer or a targeted Hero block, but ensure the core dashboard and main content areas are light (#FFFFFF or #F8FAFC). NEVER use pure black (#000000).

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg or rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-md for buttons. Avoid fully pill-shaped or brutally sharp corners.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for default cards, shadow-md on hover. Use ambient, soft shadows to create a sleek SaaS feel.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for section paddings. gap-6 to gap-8 for grids. Whitespace is critical for the corporate feel.

layouts.navigation: Sticky top nav. White background (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with subtle bottom border. Include Logo, 6 tabs, and a primary CTA.
layouts.hero: Clean split layout or focused center layout. Restrained H1. Must include Contact Info clearly (Mobile: +91 90595 65125, Email: info@nivxmachines.com) with lucide-react icons.
layouts.live_threat_dashboard: Bento-style grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). White cards on a slate-50 background. Live stats counters and a scrolling list of recent CVEs. Use Shadcn UI charts/cards.
layouts.threat_report: Cards for reports + a featured brief. Featured brief must display MITRE ATT&CK tactic IDs, Process Tree visually (can use basic flowchart style with divs/borders), and IOCs.
layouts.admin_panel: Login-gated view. Clean, centered authentication card. Once 'logged in' (mocked), show a professional, structured form (Shadcn Form/Inputs) to add/edit threat reports.

components.buttons: Shadcn UI Button. Primary: bg-[#2E7DF5] hover:bg-[#2563EB] text-white. Accent: bg-[#F5821F] hover:bg-[#EA580C] text-white. Outline: border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.cards: Shadcn UI Card. bg-white, border-slate-200, shadow-sm. Clean and structured.
components.forms: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Label. Clean white inputs with subtle focus rings (ring-[#2E7DF5]).
components.icons: lucide-react. Use stroke-width 1.5 for a professional, lighter look.

motion.animations: framer-motion for subtle fade-ins (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) on scroll. Micro-interactions on buttons (scale 0.98 on tap). No overly flashy kinetic typography.

images.description: Laptop displaying 'Cyber Security' in a modern office. Good for Hero or About Us.
Modern server room enterprise. Good for Services or Gallery.
Artificial intelligence network node. Good for AI/Tech offerings.

media.instructions: Use these images strategically. Apply rounded corners (rounded-lg) to all images to fit the SaaS look. Never use placeholder text for images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Text on brand colors must be readable.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and informational elements (e.g., data-testid='threat-report-card', data-testid='contact-email').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FILE EXTENSION: Use .js and .jsx files exclusively. Do NOT output .tsx or .ts files.
2. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: Apply Shadcn UI but customize spacing and radiuses to match the clean corporate guidelines.
3. THEME: Apply a Light-dominant theme. Replace the old pure-black/neon 'hacker' vibe with white/slate-50 backgrounds, #2E7DF5 blue, and #F5821F orange accents.
4. TYPOGRAPHY: Enforce strict restraint on font sizes. H1 must not exceed text-5xl. Use 'Outfit' for headings, 'Inter' for body.
5. SECTIONS: Implement 6 tabs: About Us, Gallery, Threat Report, Careers, Services, Support.
6. HERO & SUPPORT: Must clearly display Mobile +91 90595 65125 and Email info@nivxmachines.com.
7. THREAT REPORTS: Implement a card layout and a detailed view showing MITRE ATT&CK chain, Process Trees, and IOCs.
8. ADMIN: Include a login-gated Admin Panel with a clean form to manage threat reports.
10. TESTING: Apply data-testid to every button, link, form, and major card/section.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical for a premium feel (e.g. p-8 instead of p-4).
Prioritize existing Shadcn UI components from src/components/ui.
NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or fixed headers where content scrolls underneath.
